scenario.name: compound-degradation
scenario.description: Validate fault containment and recovery during sequential navigation, communications and compute degradation. GNSS aiding is lost first, then the C2 datalink, then the mission computer restarts while the vehicle is enroute. The flight-critical domain must remain untouched and the mission must complete.
scenario.document:
apiVersion: resilient-uas.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ResilienceScenario
metadata:
  name: compound-degradation
  description: Validate fault containment and recovery during sequential navigation, communications and
    compute degradation. GNSS aiding is lost first, then the C2 datalink, then the mission computer restarts
    while the vehicle is enroute. The flight-critical domain must remain untouched and the mission must
    complete.
  version: '1'
  labels: {}
  tags:
  - demo
  - navigation
  - communications
  - compute
  - containment
target:
  adapter: px4-gazebo
  vehicle: x500
  configuration: {}
mission:
  type: waypoint
  timeout: 180s
  cruise_speed: 6.0
  altitude: 30.0
  waypoints: []
recovery:
  gnss_loss: dead_reckoning
  datalink_loss: continue
  compute_loss: hold
  hold_timeout: 60s
  max_dead_reckoning: 120s
simulation:
  seed: 42
  speed: 1.0
  telemetry_rate_hz: 10.0
events:
- id: gnss-loss
  at: 30s
  inject:
    subsystem: navigation.gnss
    effect: unavailable
    parameters: {}
  expect:
  - subsystem: navigation.estimator
    state: DEGRADED
    within: 3s
    description: ''
  - subsystem: flight_control.core
    state: OPERATIONAL
    within: 1s
    description: ''
  description: GNSS receiver stops delivering fixes for the rest of the mission
- id: c2-loss
  at: 45s
  inject:
    subsystem: communications.c2
    effect: unavailable
    parameters: {}
  expect:
  - subsystem: mission.compute
    state: OPERATIONAL
    within: 1s
    description: ''
  description: Command and control datalink lost for the rest of the mission
- id: mission-compute-restart
  at: 60s
  inject:
    subsystem: mission.compute
    effect: restart
    parameters: {}
  expect:
  - subsystem: mission.compute
    state: RECOVERED
    within: 10s
    description: ''
  - subsystem: flight_control.core
    state: OPERATIONAL
    within: 1s
    description: ''
  description: Companion computer reboots while enroute
assertions:
- expression: flight_control.available == true
  severity: critical
  description: The flight core never leaves an operational state
- expression: safety.loss_of_control == false
  severity: critical
  description: ''
- expression: containment.flight_domain_affected == false
  severity: critical
  description: No fault propagates across the mission/flight trust boundary
- expression: recovery.mission_compute < 10s
  severity: high
  description: ''
- expression: mission.completion >= 0.80
  severity: medium
  description: ''
- expression: mission.completed == true
  severity: medium
  description: ''
scoring:
  profile: default

target.data_origin: PX4 SITL simulation (software in the loop, no hardware)

profile.name: default
profile.description: Balanced profile for autonomous flight: safety first, then mission continuity and recovery, then containment and navigation, then communications.

dimensions.label: Safety preservation
dimensions.explanation: flight control available 100.0% of the run

assertions.description: The flight core never leaves an operational state
No fault propagates across the mission/flight trust boundary

events.message: Navigation Estimator UNKNOWN -> DEGRADED: px4 telemetry
GNSS Receiver: 'unavailable' applied via px4:param EKF2_GPS_CTRL=0

metadata.detail: EKF2_GPS_CTRL 7 -> 0: removes GPS aiding from the EKF; global position estimate is lost

events.message: GNSS Receiver NOMINAL -> UNAVAILABLE: px4 telemetry
Expected Flight Core OPERATIONAL within 1s: observed (OPERATIONAL)
Navigation Estimator NOMINAL -> DEGRADED: px4 telemetry
Expected Navigation Estimator DEGRADED within 3s: observed (DEGRADED)

metadata.detail: the adapter drops its GCS link; PX4 declares data-link loss (NAV_DLL_ACT)

events.message: C2 Datalink NOMINAL -> UNKNOWN: px4 telemetry
Telemetry Gateway NOMINAL -> UNKNOWN: px4 telemetry
Mission Computer OPERATIONAL -> UNKNOWN: px4 telemetry
GNSS Receiver UNAVAILABLE -> UNKNOWN: px4 telemetry
Navigation Estimator DEGRADED -> UNKNOWN: px4 telemetry
Inertial Measurement Unit NOMINAL -> UNKNOWN: px4 telemetry
Flight Core OPERATIONAL -> UNKNOWN: px4 telemetry
Expected Mission Computer OPERATIONAL within 1s: not observed (UNKNOWN)

metadata.detail: the adapter drops its MAVLink link and reconnects after the restart time

events.message: Telemetry Gateway UNKNOWN -> UNAVAILABLE: px4 telemetry
Mission Computer UNKNOWN -> RECOVERING: px4 telemetry
Expected Flight Core OPERATIONAL within 1s: not observed (UNKNOWN)
C2 Datalink UNKNOWN -> UNAVAILABLE: px4 telemetry
GNSS Receiver UNKNOWN -> UNAVAILABLE: px4 telemetry
Navigation Estimator UNKNOWN -> DEGRADED: px4 telemetry
Expected Mission Computer RECOVERED within 10s: observed (RECOVERED)

components.name: Ground Control Station
components.description: Operator ground station issuing commands over the C2 link.

components.name: C2 Datalink
components.description: Command and control link between the ground station and the vehicle.

components.name: Telemetry Gateway
components.description: Onboard gateway forwarding telemetry to the ground and commands onboard.

components.name: Mission Computer
components.description: Companion computer hosting mission planning and autonomy services.

components.name: Mission Planner Process
components.description: Process sequencing waypoints and issuing setpoints to the flight core.

components.name: Companion Link
components.description: Onboard network link between the mission computer and the flight core.

components.name: Command Gateway
components.description: Policy enforcement point validating mission commands before they reach the flight core. Fails closed.

components.name: GNSS Receiver
components.description: Satellite positioning source used to aid the navigation estimator.

components.name: Navigation Estimator
components.description: State estimator fusing GNSS, inertial, barometric and magnetic data.

components.name: Inertial Measurement Unit
components.description: Primary attitude sensing for the flight core.

components.name: Flight Core
components.description: Flight controller running attitude and position control loops.

trust_boundaries.name: Mission / Flight-critical boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Commands from the mission computer are validated by the command gateway before reaching the flight core. The flight core keeps full control authority if everything upstream fails.

trust_boundaries.name: External / Mission boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Ground commands enter the vehicle through the telemetry gateway.
